title: Sharp stability for mixed bubbles on hyperbolic space
summary: We prove sharp residual stability estimates for the critical Poincaré-Sobolev equation near sums of one positive hyperbolic solution and one projected Euclidean bubble in dimensions at least four. The estimates are uniform in the relative positions of the centers. The sharp rate is linear except in dimension six, where it contains a square root of a logarithm. For nonnegative functions, the same estimates hold under an energy constraint near the sum of the two profile energies for \(λ\) outside a finite set, and an additional mass constraint removes this restriction.
